blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday arrived at Malacañang, where he was welcomed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Trump was accorded with arrival honors at the Malacañang compound and before proceeding to a bilateral meeting with Marcos. The US President arrived in the country on Tuesday to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-US Special Summit. /dl READ: Trump arrives in Manila for Asean-US special summit, Marcos meeting...
